d:
Meet Ripu Raman— the Bihari businessman who built a ₹1000 crore empire in Bihar. In a state where setting up industries is full of challenges, how did he make it happen? What hurdles do industrialists face in Bihar? Can industries help stop migration from the state?
Find all the answers in this episode of Hum Bihar Ke Log—a special series by The Lallantop.
Reported by Vikas Verma, Amitesh Kumar, and Shivani Dalakoti.
Production: Vikas Verma, Amitesh Kumar, Shivani Dalakoti
Camera & Edit: Amitesh Kumar
